facts.fact: The DPSSF page describes Kénon as a unified database centralising data on vulnerable families and beneficiaries of programmes such as Programa Família, and as producing reports for both PEP+ and Programa Família; it names no exchange with the ID, civil registration or other government systems. Dated by its published date, 2025-04-22.

systems.owner: Direção da Proteção Social, Solidariedade e Família (DPSSF)
